source_note: 一个竞赛中的和的渐近展开问题
english_source_note: An Asymptotic Expansion Problem for a Sum
callout_id: 一个竞赛中的和的渐近展开问题#2
statement_en:
If the required accuracy of the asymptotic expansion of $S_n$ is $O(g(n))$, and there is another known asymptotic expansion for a sum $S'_n$ with the same accuracy $O(g(n))$, and moreover
$$S_n-S_n'=O(g(n)),$$
then the asymptotic expansions of $S_n$ and $S'_n$ are the same up to accuracy $O(g(n))$.
callout_body: 如果我们对$S_n$的渐近展开的精度要求为$O(g(n))$,而此时恰好有另一个已知渐近展开结果，且精度也为$O(g(n))$的和$S'_n$，同时$$S_n-S_n'=O(g(n))$$那么$S_n,S_n'$的渐近展开在$O(g(n))$的精度下是相同的。
